description.en: Lightweight self-hosted server monitoring panel. Real-time metrics and 2FA security. Built because I needed something simple to keep an eye on my home server.
description.zh: 轻量级的自托管服务器监控面板，提供实时指标和双重身份验证。因为想找个简单的办法看一眼家里的服务器状态，所以干脆自己做了一个。

description.en: Multi-LLM chat workspace. Debate mode makes models argue and synthesize answers. Self-hosted, Docker, Ollama, streaming, auth and more.
description.zh: 多模型聊天工作区。辩论模式会让多个模型先互相讨论，再整理出答案。支持自托管、Docker、Ollama、流式输出和登录验证等功能。

description.en: A Raspberry Pi watchdog for my home network. Checks services, internet access, DNS, and power, with a local dashboard and OLED status display. With a battery supply and Meshtastic radio, it can keep monitoring and send alerts during internet or mains outages. Also integrates with Home Assistant.
description.zh: 给家庭网络做的树莓派监控系统，检查服务、互联网连接、DNS 和供电状态，通过本地仪表盘和 OLED 显示运行情况。搭配电池供电与 Meshtastic 无线电，即使断网或停电也能继续监控并发送告警，还能接入 Home Assistant。

alt.en: PiWatch dashboard showing service health, system metrics, and heartbeat reporting
alt.zh: PiWatch 仪表盘，展示服务健康状态、系统指标和心跳上报情况

description.en: An Android 13+ app for managing IMS and network settings per SIM. Brings VoLTE, Wi-Fi calling, VoNR, and 5G controls into a Material 3 interface, with original-value backups and recovery. Still in development, primarily for Tensor Pixels; support depends on firmware, modem, and carrier.
description.zh: 面向 Android 13 及以上版本的 IMS 与网络配置应用，按 SIM 卡管理 VoLTE、Wi-Fi 通话、VoNR 和 5G 设置，采用 Material 3 界面，并提供原值备份与恢复。目前仍在开发中，主要面向 Tensor Pixel，实际支持情况取决于固件、基带和运营商。

alt.en: UltimateIMS app logo from the repository
alt.zh: UltimateIMS 仓库中的应用标志

description.en: A lightweight Jellyfin web client that gives older iPads another job. Browse your library, stream video, and pick between modern and retro interfaces. Built for iPad 2 and iOS 9.
description.zh: 给旧 iPad 找个新用途的轻量级 Jellyfin 网页客户端。支持浏览媒体库、在线播放视频，还能切换现代和复古界面，专为 iPad 2 和 iOS 9 打造。

alt.zh: Finstalgia 现代模式媒体库设计预览
Finstalgia 复古模式媒体库设计预览

description.en: An audio CD player for RGH Xbox 360 consoles. Plays physical discs offline, while a Python helper on the local network looks up track names and cover art through MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive. Includes track selection, repeat, and tray controls, with no Xbox Live account needed.
description.zh: 给 RGH Xbox 360 做的音频 CD 播放器，可离线播放实体光盘。局域网中的 Python 辅助服务通过 MusicBrainz 和 Cover Art Archive 获取曲目名称与封面，支持选曲、循环播放和光驱托盘控制，无需 Xbox Live 账号。

alt.en: DiscCue 360 playback UI rendered from app code with a sample album, track list, and controls
alt.zh: DiscCue 360 从应用代码渲染的播放界面，展示示例专辑、曲目列表和控制按钮

alt.en: DiscCue 360 tray-open screen rendered from app code
alt.zh: DiscCue 360 从应用代码渲染的光驱托盘开启界面

description.en: A native macOS app for turning FLAC albums into audio CDs with automatic CD-Text. Drag in an album, review the metadata, and burn. Everything runs offline.
description.zh: 把 FLAC 专辑刻录成音频 CD 的 macOS 原生应用，自动写入 CD-Text。拖入专辑、检查元数据，再开始刻录，整个流程都能离线完成。

alt.en: CDScribe app showing FLAC album import and audio CD burning controls
alt.zh: CDScribe 应用中的 FLAC 专辑导入和音频 CD 刻录界面

description.en: A GNSS and PPS timing dashboard for my Raspberry Pi. Shows satellite reception, chrony status, and clock estimates from the Pi in a browser on the local network.
description.zh: 给树莓派做的 GNSS 和 PPS 授时仪表盘。在局域网浏览器里查看卫星接收情况、chrony 状态，以及基于树莓派时间的时钟估算。

alt.zh: ZenithTick 卫星与授时仪表盘

description.en: You're looking at it right now.
Web UI for managing PM2 processes. Start, stop, restart, and monitor Node.js apps from a browser instead of a terminal.
description.zh: 用网页管理 PM2 进程，可以直接启动、停止、重启和监控 Node.js 应用，不用再来回敲终端命令。

description.en: Voice assistant satellite for Home Assistant built on an ESP32-S3 with a microphone. Part of my home automation setup.
description.zh: 基于带麦克风的 ESP32-S3 做的 Home Assistant 语音卫星，是家里自动化系统的一部分。

description.en: DragonSea MC is a Forge-based city-building community. We're building a fully fictional nation and city with room for architects and explorers alike.
description.zh: 龙海是一个基于 Forge 的城市建设社区。我们正在一起创造一个完全虚构的国家和城市，不管你喜欢盖房子还是探索，都能找到适合自己的位置。

description.en: Aviation and railway photography platform built with React, Vite, and Node.js. It grew to more than 2,600 registered users and 23,800 photos before the website was discontinued.
description.zh: 使用 React、Vite 和 Node.js 构建的航空与铁路摄影平台。网站停止运营前拥有超过 2,600 名注册用户和 23,800 张照片。
